source_instruction: i need this product for afternoon snack with friends .rhythm superfoods carrot sticks,1.4 oz (pack of 12), vegan/gluten-free superfood snacks
query: Ugh, you won’t believe the mess I dealt with right before I walked into the store today—our golden retriever, Muffin, dug through the bottom of the hall closet this morning, dragged out every single old winter scarf, mitten, and crumpled holiday gift bag we’ve stashed there since 2021, and shredded half a roll of sparkly red wrapping paper all over the entryway rug. I was already running 10 minutes late to drop the kid off at school, so I had to kick all the paper scraps into a pile by the front door, sprint to the car, and I swear I still have a little piece of that glitter stuck to my left cheek even now, I kept catching little flecks of it falling onto my steering wheel on the drive over. The crossing guard even waved extra slow at me when I pulled up to the school drop-off loop, I bet she thought I was covered in some weird craft supply the kid dumped on me before we left the house, it was so embarrassing. Hey, I’m over in the frozen section right now grabbing snacks for my kid’s lunch next week, can you help me track down the nut free ones? I need to grab that one, the pack size I always get when I stock up for the month, y’know? I don’t wanna spend too much, obviously, so just stick to something reasonable that won’t break the bank, yeah? Let me know what you find that fits, I don’t have a ton of time to wander the aisles today.
